help.update_profile_intro: Your Account Settings page lets you manage your name, email address, timezone, and password.
help.update_name_step1: Click "Account Settings" in the sidebar navigation.
help.update_name_step2: Edit your name in the Personal Information section.
help.settings_page_contains: The Account Settings page is organized into four sections:
help.your_name_desc: Your display name, shown throughout the platform and in emails.
help.your_email_desc: Your login and contact email. Changing it requires verification of the new address.
help.your_timezone_desc: Controls how dates and deadlines are displayed to you.
help.your_password_desc: Your account password. You need your current password to change it.
help.change_email_step2: In the Email section, type your new email address.
help.change_email_step4: Check the inbox of your new email address for a verification link.
help.change_email_step5: Click the link to confirm. Your email will be updated once verified.
help.change_email_note1: Your old email will remain active until you verify the new one.
help.change_email_note2: A notification is sent to your old email when the change completes.
help.change_email_note3: If the new email is already in use by another account, the change will not be allowed.
help.change_pw_step4: Enter your new password and confirm it.
help.pw_tip_min_chars: Must be at least 8 characters long.
help.pw_tip_mix: Use a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols for a stronger password.
help.pw_tip_avoid_common: Avoid easily guessable passwords like "password" or "12345678".
help.change_lang_intro: You can switch the interface language using the language switcher in the top navigation bar.
help.change_lang_step1: Look for the language name (e.g., "English") in the top navigation bar.
help.change_lang_step2: Click it to open the language menu.
help.change_lang_step3: Select your preferred language — the page updates immediately.
help.change_lang_note1: The language change applies to all interface text, menus, and system messages.
help.change_lang_note2: Form content and user-submitted data are not translated — only the interface changes.
help.set_tz_step2: In the Timezone section, select your timezone from the dropdown.
help.set_tz_why_desc: Your timezone controls how all dates, deadlines, and timestamps are shown to you across the platform.
help.tz_reason1: Form and program deadlines are displayed in your local time.
help.tz_reason2: Submission dates and timestamps reflect your timezone.
help.tz_reason3: Reminder notifications are sent at appropriate local times.
help.find_forms_step2: Browse the list of available forms, or use the search bar to find a specific one.
help.find_forms_step3: Click on a form to view its details and start filling it out.
help.find_forms_dashboard_desc: Your dashboard also shows recently available forms for quick access.
help.fill_form_start_step1: Navigate to a form from the Forms page or your dashboard.
help.fill_form_start_step2: Read the form description and any instructions at the top.
help.fill_form_start_step3: Answer each question — required fields are marked with an asterisk (*).
help.fill_form_types_heading: Types of Questions You May See
help.fill_form_type_text_desc: Type your answer into a single-line or multi-line text field.
help.fill_form_type_select_desc: Select one or more options from a list.
help.fill_form_type_file_desc: Attach a file from your device. Allowed formats and size limits are shown on the field.
help.fill_form_type_date_desc: Pick a date using the calendar, or type it in manually.
help.fill_form_required_tip: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required — you cannot submit the form without completing them.
help.qtype_text_desc: Short answer (single line) or long answer (multi-line text area).
help.qtype_choice_desc: Radio buttons (pick one), checkboxes (pick multiple), or dropdowns.
help.qtype_file_desc: Upload documents or images. Allowed formats and size limits are shown on the field.
help.qtype_date_desc: Pick a date using the calendar picker, or enter it manually.
help.qtype_number_desc: Enter a numeric value. May have minimum or maximum limits.
help.fill_form_note1: Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*) — you must complete them before submitting.
help.fill_form_note2: Some questions may appear or hide depending on your previous answers.
help.fill_form_note3: You can save your progress as a draft at any time and come back later.
help.save_draft_step1: While filling out a form, click the "Save Draft" button.
help.save_draft_step2: Your progress is saved immediately — you'll see a confirmation message.
help.save_draft_step3: You can safely close your browser and return later.
help.save_draft_continue_step1: Go to "My Submissions" and filter by "Drafts".
help.save_draft_continue_step3: Pick up where you left off, then save again or submit.
help.save_draft_tip: Save frequently when working on long forms to avoid losing your progress.
help.upload_step1: Click the file upload field, or drag and drop your file into the upload area.
help.upload_step2: Wait for the upload to complete — a file name and icon will appear.
help.upload_step3: To replace a file, remove the current one and upload a new one.
help.upload_limit_formats: Allowed formats are shown on each upload field (commonly PDF, DOC, JPG, PNG).
help.upload_limit_size: Maximum file size is displayed on the field (varies by form).
help.upload_limit_replace: You can remove an uploaded file and replace it before submitting.
help.upload_trouble1: Check that your file doesn't exceed the size limit.
help.upload_trouble2: Make sure the file format is one of the allowed types.
help.upload_trouble3: Try a different browser or check your internet connection.
help.upload_tip1: Use a stable internet connection — interruptions can cause uploads to fail.
help.upload_tip2: Make sure the file is not open in another programme before uploading.
help.upload_tip3: If an upload fails, remove the file and try uploading it again.
help.submit_check1: All required fields (marked with *) are filled in.
help.submit_check3: You've reviewed your answers for accuracy.
help.submit_warning: Once submitted, you may not be able to edit your form. Review all your answers carefully before clicking Submit.
help.submit_step1: Click the "Submit" button at the bottom of the form.
help.submit_step2: You'll see a confirmation page with your submission details.
help.submit_step3: A confirmation email is sent to your email address.
help.submit_after1: Your submission status changes to "Submitted" and is visible in My Submissions.
help.submit_after2: Administrators are notified and will review your submission.
help.submit_after3: You'll receive notifications when the status of your submission changes.
help.edit_sub_intro: Whether you can edit a submitted form depends on how the administrator configured it. Some forms allow edits after submission, while others are locked once submitted.
help.edit_sub_step1: Go to My Submissions and click on the submission you want to edit.
help.edit_sub_step2: Click the "Edit" button on the submission page.
help.edit_sub_step4: Click "Save Changes" to update your submission.
help.edit_sub_note1: Drafts can always be edited — just click "Continue" from My Submissions.
help.edit_sub_note2: If editing is not available and you need to make changes, you may need to wait for a clarification request from the administrator.
help.edit_sub_note: If the form is locked after submission and you need to make a change, contact the administrator or wait for a clarification request.
help.programs_intro: A program groups multiple forms together into a single application. For example, a scholarship program might require an application form, a transcript upload, and a recommendation letter — all submitted together.
help.programs_how1: Browse available programs and open the one you want to apply to.
help.programs_how2: Complete each required form listed in the program.
help.programs_how3: Attach your submitted forms and submit your program entry before the deadline.
help.programs_example1: A scholarship requiring an application form, transcript, and recommendation letters.
help.programs_example2: A grant requiring a proposal, budget spreadsheet, and supporting documents.
help.programs_example3: An admissions process requiring several evaluation forms.
help.programs_detail_heading: What You'll See on a Program Page
help.programs_detail_desc: When you open a program, you'll find:
help.programs_detail1: The list of required forms you need to complete.
help.programs_detail2: A deadline for the program submission (if one is set).
help.programs_detail3: Your progress — which forms you've already attached.
help.programs_detail4: Rules and instructions from the administrator.
help.apply_prog_step1_desc: Click "Programs" in the sidebar, then select the program you want to apply to.
help.apply_prog_step2_desc: Each form listed must have a submitted entry. You can fill a new one or attach an existing submission.
help.apply_prog_step3_desc: For each required form, select the submission you want to include from the dropdown.
help.apply_prog_step4_desc: Once all forms are attached, click "Submit Program Entry" to finalize your application.
help.apply_prog_reuse_tip: If multiple programs require the same form, you can submit it once and attach it to each program — no need to fill it out again.
help.apply_prog_tip: Make sure all required forms are submitted before you submit your program entry — you cannot finalise the application with missing forms.
help.track_app_step1: Click "My Programs" in the sidebar navigation.
help.track_app_step2: You'll see a list of all your program applications and their current status.
help.track_app_step3: Click on any application to view its full details, attached forms, and review stage.
help.track_status_draft_desc: You haven't submitted the application yet — forms may still need attaching.
help.track_status_submitted_desc: Your application has been submitted and is waiting for review.
help.track_status_review_desc: Your application is currently being evaluated by reviewers.
help.track_status_pending_desc: Your application has been received and is waiting to be assigned for review.
help.view_subs_intro: Click "My Submissions" in the sidebar to see all your form submissions in one place.
help.view_subs_columns: The table shows each submission's form name, status, date, and available actions (Continue for drafts, View for submitted forms).
help.view_subs_filter_desc: Use the filter tabs at the top to narrow your list:
help.filter_draft_desc: Submissions you haven't finished yet. Click "Continue" to keep working.
help.filter_submitted_desc: Forms you've submitted and are waiting on.
help.filter_clarification_desc: Submissions where the administrator has asked for more information.
help.statuses_intro: Each submission has a status that tells you where it is in the process.
help.statuses_draft_desc: This form hasn't been submitted yet. You can continue editing and submit when ready.
help.statuses_submitted_desc: Your form has been submitted successfully. An administrator will review it.
help.statuses_clarification_desc: An administrator has requested clarification on one or more questions. Go to Clarification Requests to respond.
help.status_draft_desc: You have started the form but have not submitted it yet. You can continue editing at any time.
help.status_submitted_desc: Your form has been received and is waiting for an administrator to review it.
help.status_in_review_desc: An administrator is currently reviewing your submission.
help.status_approved_desc: Your submission has been reviewed and approved.
help.status_rejected_desc: Your submission has been reviewed and was not approved.
help.status_clarification_desc: An administrator has asked you to provide more information before the review can continue.
help.clar_what_intro: A clarification request is when an administrator reviewing your submission asks you to provide additional information, elaborate on an answer, or correct something you submitted.
help.clar_what_happens_heading: What Happens When a Clarification is Requested?
help.clar_happens1: You receive a notification by email and through the notification bell.
help.clar_happens2: Open the clarification request to see which questions need your attention.
help.clar_happens3: Submit your response — the administrator is notified and continues the review.
help.clar_why1: An answer needs more detail or explanation.
help.clar_why2: An uploaded document is unclear or missing.
help.clar_why3: A response needs to be corrected or updated.
help.clar_how_know2: An alert banner appears on your dashboard.
help.clar_how_know3: The notification bell shows a badge.
help.clar_how_know4: Your submission status changes to "Clarification Requested".
help.clar_respond_promptly: Respond promptly to clarification requests to avoid delays in your review.
help.clar_respond_step1_desc: Go to "Clarification Requests" in the sidebar, or click the notification link.
help.clar_respond_step2_desc: Read the administrator's message and the specific questions that need your attention.
help.clar_respond_step3_desc: For each flagged question, type your additional information or correct your answer.
help.clar_respond_step4_desc: Click "Submit Response" to send your clarification back to the administrator.
help.clar_respond_after1: The administrator is notified of your response.
help.clar_respond_after2: They may accept your response and continue the review.
help.clar_respond_after3: Or they may send a follow-up request if more information is needed.
help.clar_types_intro: When an administrator requests clarification, each question is flagged as one of two types:
help.clar_type_info_desc: The administrator needs more detail or context. You provide additional information in a separate response field. Your original answer stays unchanged.
help.clar_type_info_example: You answered "5 years experience" — the admin asks you to list your specific roles and employers.
help.clar_type_info_ex1: "Please provide more details about your work experience."
help.clar_type_info_ex2: "Can you clarify what you meant by your answer in question 3?"
help.clar_type_doc_desc: The administrator needs you to upload a specific document that was missing or could not be read.
help.clar_type_doc_ex1: "Please upload a clearer scan of your passport."
help.clar_type_doc_ex2: "The certificate you uploaded appears to be cut off — please re-upload the full document."
help.clar_type_correction_desc: The administrator has identified an error in your answer and is asking you to fix it.
help.clar_type_correction_ex1: "The date you entered does not match the document you uploaded."
help.clar_type_correction_ex2: "Please correct your contact number — the format entered is not valid."
help.clar_type_rect_desc: The administrator needs you to correct or replace your original answer. You modify the actual form field with the updated information.
help.clar_type_rect_example: You uploaded the wrong document — the admin asks you to upload the correct certificate.
help.notif_bell_desc: The bell icon in the top-right corner of the page shows your recent notifications.
help.notif_bell_step1: Click the bell icon to open the notifications panel.
help.notif_bell_step2: Click any notification to view its details or navigate to the related item.
help.notif_bell_step3: A badge on the bell shows how many unread notifications you have.
help.notif_action1: Click a notification to mark it as read.
help.notif_action2: Use "Mark all as read" to clear the unread count.
help.notif_action3: Use "Clear all" to remove all notifications from the panel.
help.notif_type1: Submission confirmations — when your form is submitted successfully.
help.notif_type2: Status changes — when your submission moves to a new status.
help.notif_type3: Clarification requests — when an administrator needs more information.
help.notif_type4: Deadline reminders — when a form or program deadline is approaching.
help.notif_type5: Draft reminders — when you have incomplete drafts waiting.
help.email_nr_check1_title: Check your spam or junk folder
help.email_nr_check1_desc: Platform emails sometimes get filtered. Look in your spam/junk folder and mark them as "not spam".
help.email_nr_check2_title: Confirm your email address is correct
help.email_nr_check2_desc: Go to Account Settings and make sure the email shown is the one you're checking.
help.email_nr_check3_title: Make sure your email is verified
help.email_nr_check3_desc: Unverified emails may not receive notifications. Look for the verified badge in your settings.
help.email_nr_check4_desc: Email delivery can sometimes be delayed. If you just performed an action, wait a moment and check again.
help.email_nr_still_not: If you've checked everything above and still aren't receiving emails, contact your administrator for assistance.
help.mfa_what_desc: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. After entering your password, you are also required to enter a one-time code generated by an authenticator app on your phone.
help.mfa_why1: Protects your account even if your password is stolen.
help.mfa_why2: Prevents unauthorised access from unfamiliar devices.
help.mfa_why3: May be required depending on your account role.
help.mfa_enable_step1: Go to Account Settings and click the "Security" tab.
help.mfa_enable_step2: In the Two-Factor Authentication section, click "Enable 2FA".
help.mfa_enable_step3: Enter your current password to verify your identity and click Continue.
help.mfa_enable_step4: You will be signed out and prompted to complete the 2FA setup on your next login.
help.mfa_setup_step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy).
help.mfa_setup_step2: Scan the QR code shown on the screen using your authenticator app.
help.mfa_setup_step3: If you cannot scan the code, click "Can't scan the code?" to reveal a manual entry key.
help.mfa_setup_step4: Enter the 6-digit verification code from your app to confirm the setup.
help.mfa_setup_step5: Save your recovery code securely — it is shown only once.
help.mfa_setup_step6: Click "I've saved my recovery code" to finish setup and log in.
help.mfa_login_step1: Enter your email address and password as normal.
help.mfa_login_step2: Open your authenticator app and find the 6-digit code for this platform.
help.mfa_login_step3: Enter the code on the verification screen and click Continue.
help.mfa_login_tip: Codes refresh every 30 seconds. If a code is rejected, wait for a new code to appear in your app and try again.
help.mfa_recovery_desc: Your recovery code allows you to access your account if you lose your phone or can no longer use your authenticator app. Using it will remove 2FA from your account — you will be prompted to set it up again on your next login.
help.mfa_recovery_warning_desc: Recovery codes can only be used once and are not stored by the platform — they cannot be retrieved after setup. Store yours in a password manager or in a secure printed document.
help.mfa_change_desc: If you get a new phone or switch authenticator apps, go to Account Settings > Security and click "Change 2FA". You will need to enter your current password and a valid code from your existing authenticator app to proceed.
